data.short_meaning: God's name, rule, or God of death
data.long_meaning: Ritesh (Ri-tesh) is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rit' which means 'right' and 'to rule'. Kumar is a Sanskrit name meaning 'son of'. So, Riteshkumar can be interpreted as 'son of the one who rules right'. This name is often given to babies born in Hindu families. The name Riteshkumar carries the meaning “God's name, rule, or God of death” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Riteshkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody god's name, rule, or god of death and live with faith, good character and purpose.
